webslinger_skill_description: Swinging on webs, zipping to rooftops and crawling on walls. Webs reach further, zips pull faster, swings fling harder and every move costs less. From skill 0 to 100: swing webs of {reach0} to {reach100} m, zips of {zip0} to {zip100} m, and moves up to {cut}% cheaper.
webslinger_hint_swing: Swinging! Keep holding Jump to keep swinging, steer with the move keys, let go near the top of a swing to fly.
webslinger_hint_zip: Zip! Sprint in the air pulls you to the spot under the crosshair.
webslinger_hint_airzip: Nothing in reach: a zip forward. A few per jump.
webslinger_hint_crawl: On the wall: move keys crawl, Sprint faster, Jump kicks off, Crouch lets go.
webslinger_shooters_desc: A pair of wrist gadgets that shoot webs. Wear them to swing on webs (Jump in the air) and zip to the spot under the crosshair (Sprint in the air).
webslinger_hint_leap: Spider leap! With the Web Shooters on, press Jump in the air to swing from a web.
webslinger_suit_desc: A red and blue web suit with a mask, a leather belt, leather bracers and fur-topped boots. Worn in the trinket slot, it changes how you look, not what you wear: your armour stays on and keeps protecting you, and your helmet and cape take the suit's colours.
webslinger_suit_venom_desc: A living black suit with a huge white spider, jagged white eyes and a grin of fangs, in black leather, silver and grey fur. Your webs turn black. Worn in the trinket slot, it changes how you look, not what you wear: your armour stays on, and your helmet and cape turn black.
